content: Bulus Dlǝli Gawasi Akina ki Aglibas
Iki i Aglippa ul Bulus su, “A ndǝgi ki'shilǝni a'dlǝli gawagi.” I Bulus ta'toh lya I'gob shilǝn I'usu:
“A mbi zo' asǝn i Guu Aglippa, nǝ dǝmniki akina ɗa'ka ta dlǝli ta shilǝn asǝti u tǝn mus ship shilǝn u nǝ Yahudawa pǝli u,
Nǝ dǝm niki Ki mul ma' lǝɓani ge'dǝb ki Yahudawa u nǝ shilǝn wasǝn u. Ami ngepki ki' ga'ki kǝm nǝ ngaptibi.
“Mus mbalǝn ki Yahudawa sǝman dǝmtini a ɗǝ ya'ni, tun tlǝ tini age atlini, nǝ a Ulshelima.
Sǝman nǝni tun teɗe ǝn sǝn dlǝb ulnǝs mani tǝnkǝn u, Sǝmani ami mul bǝtl ɗalika mul ndǝl tuni ge' bǝtl Lya inǝn, a pǝlǝn dǝpkǝ mul palisa.
Nǝguni tǝn gaki la'tti mbadlǝ tǝn dlǝlliti u nǝ Lya pǝli mi'zǝ' mi'zǝm mini u i lakiɗa ami ki dlǝli tǝ pǝli shilǝn ɗa asǝti.
Guki dlǝlliti ki bi inǝn kutl nǝ lop ginǝ ɗǝ la'ti mbatl nǝ bǝtl Lya gasi nǝ dloncin si la'ti mbadli sǝ'en njikǝn twasi. Guu Aglippa, gaki la'ti mbaldlu Yahudwa ɗǝ pǝltǝn nǝ shilǝn ɗa.
Yalaki ɗa tǝn yenti wakǝn Lya kǝn ma'tlil mi'mǝshtwaiya?
“Teɗi ammi gayi ni ya yeni kǝnǝ mbunni tapǝl lǝɓa iye' ki kon nǝshin ki Yesu mul nazalat.
Nǝgu apǝli a Ulshelima. Tǝn ndǝ'ti ki bas lǝɓasi ala' mbalǝn mi'bǝtl Yesu kal dimbǝli age'lu kǝndǝ' mbalǝn, hal ɓal tlwassi u, ami pǝ' kal ki nǝgu.
Cin diɓǝli atle bǝtl lu dobga ki Yahudawa a ami pǝlissi ngashti, ami la'tisi sǝn nge Lya. Gaki kub dutugwasǝn, a ami bǝtlsi kali hal tyage' atlen a ami pǝli'si ngashti.
“Age' nǝguni, ami lǝ' Dimaskus nǝ ndǝ'ti ki bas lǝɓasi nǝ shinkǝn wasǝn.
Adlocin, Guu Aglippa, ami tǝn shitu nǝgu, yayen chilti sul lya, ngǝtl chin, nǝ chilti, ɗǝ chitl a malgǝn ini ne' elsǝni dutini.
Musi nǝn in nda atli, yakum yalon ɗǝ ussu nǝbi ki Alamai, ‘shaulu, shaulu, Yaki pǝlitǝn besǝn lǝɓaɗa? Bǝna ki ɗa katl nǝki nge tǝn u.’
“Ya usu ki okǝni, mul nalti?’ I mul ban usu. “Amiki Yesu, gunǝ ki pǝlitǝn ngashtu,’
Hilya ki' dlǝl tǝn Asǝn wagi. A mbǝn ma'ku ki'dǝm mul kyautǝn i ɗani, a' dlǝm ulnǝ' eni tǝnkǝn u ɗa, nǝ ulnǝ ta dlǝmi' a kina ki u.
An pekǝtl ki ɗǝge' mbalǝn wagi nǝ ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u, ginǝ tashin ki swa ma si u.

Gaki ki' ɓulisi dwaɗǝn, sǝppete ɗǝge' dǝmshal, as paltya' tǝn chilti, as pe'ɗǝge' gukki shedan as paltǝn guk ki Lya, nǝnǝgu nǝn pacisi besǝn laɓa wasǝn ɗa sǝn dǝm ne' mus nǝginǝ peshsi u, tǝn gaki sa la'mbatl nǝ ami i.’
“Gaki nǝgu, Guu Aglippa, a nge ndǝ'ti nǝ tlu'tu nǝ pe'sul lya uwai.

A Damascu a pisi shilǝn ki Lya pa, nǝ a Ulshelima nǝ mus alt ki Yahudiya, a pa ya pǝli mi'ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u, shilǝn ki Lya sǝ'za'pǝtl bezǝn lǝɓawasǝn sǝ' palte' ma' Lya aspǝl kyautǝn u nǝ mbo'totin patl te ma' Lya wasǝn u.
Gaki nǝgu Yahudawa goppǝn ɗa a ge'libi ki Lya is ngayi sǝ'tloɗa.
Amma i Lya ɗǝlǝni hal i mbǝl nǝguni; i laki ɗa ami dlǝmi' mbalǝn shilǝn ki Lya bazi nǝ mil a ami dlǝb ulnǝ bǝ a shoti nǝ mi'nje'shinkǝn ki Lya nǝ Musa dlǝmi nǝn ndatu.
Sǝ usu Almasihu nǝn tle' bǝna ti hilya ɗǝ ge'mi'mǝshti pa, atl dlǝmi Yahudawa cilti ki pe'ti nǝ ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u.”
Bulus age' shilǝn kǝn ngu, i Pestus tlǝl yali nǝ ndǝlti i ultisu! “Ki Bulus ga a gǝliki, “Pǝtl lashtiwa' eye u ɗǝ gǝlli'ga.”
Amma i Bulus usu. “Mulnalti Pestus,” Ga a gǝliwai, “Balini ami dlǝmti nǝ mbatl nǝm.
Guu Aglippa amma' shilǝn nǝki nǝ mbatl nǝm. A mani ka zi mus usi nǝ dwaɗǝ, pǝlin dli ki hwundǝliwai.
Guu Agilipa, ka ndǝ' ni nǝmi' nje shinkǝn ki Lyawa? Amani ka ndǝgi.”
I Agilipa ul Bulus su, “Kǝn ɗǝ yenti ge' yakǝn cin u kǝn la'tǝni adǝm Kilista ya?”
I Bulus usu, “Ko ge' yakǝn cin, koge' pya'si, ami shilǝn nǝ Lya bǝ ki nǝmwai nǝ mus ginǝ ɗǝ gakti kǝm asǝti u, sǝn dǝmti kǝnǝ ami, kidai bannǝ zhim domu.”
I Guu hilya, nǝ mul kina Pestus nǝ Balniki, nǝ ginǝ ki dǝmi ne'tu.
Kalkǝ za'ti kǝb swasǝn, is pal shilǝn ne'elsǝni, “Mulgu tapǝl ulnǝ tǝ mbalǝn tloti ko kǝndǝ'twai.
Agilipa ul Pestus su, “Tǝ gaki tǝ ɓewlǝn shilǝn u kina ma' Kaisal lwai u, a ndali tǝ za' mulu.”
